_comment: ag3s-verifier. 숫자와 경로만. 프레임별 전체 값: outputs/verify/T20/T20.verify.programmatic.json (write_verify.py) 및 numbers.*.full 경로

runs.command: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work /mnt/dev/work/.venv-ag3s/bin/python -m benchmark.trajopt.experiments.esdf_rollout --records run_16d_ep1800 --attention benchmark/ag3s/asset/data/attention_16d_ep1800.npz --frames 15 --voxel 0.020 --esdf-margin 0.05 --cameras all --support-surfaces field --constraint-links arms --out-json outputs/verify/T20/baseline.json
runs.concurrent_load: another session's benchmark.trajopt.experiments.fixed_input_ablation (pid 4141313, ~350% CPU) was running during this baseline; feasible/violated counts are therefore not comparable

runs.what: ground_target without confirm on every chunk; seeds / status / n_clusters / best score compared with the chunk's recorded seed_indices and summary_json

runs.command: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work src/openpi/.venv/bin/python outputs/verify/T20/replay_t14.py sweep <min_score> <lost_frames>  (12 settings)
runs.raw_output: outputs/verify/T20/t14_replay_min{m}_lost{l}.json; summary outputs/verify/T20/t14_sweep_summary.json (summarize_t14.py); per-frame lines in handoff/T20.verify.partial.json (kind=t14_replay)

outputs/verify/T20/synth_rows.json; summary outputs/verify/T20/synth_summary.json (summarize_synth.py); calibration outputs/verify/T20/synth_calib.log; per-frame lines in handoff/T20.verify.partial.json (kind=synthetic)

t14_replay_inputs.source: outputs/live_test/20260928_t14/server_constraints/run_0000/chunk_{k:05d}.npz, seq = k+1, k = 0..30 replayed in order
t14_replay_inputs.attention_cloud: attention_cloud (float32 -> float64); equal to filtered_cloud in 31/31 chunks
t14_replay_inputs.config: AG3SConfig() defaults: clustering (dbscan eps 0.03 min_points 20, target_confirm_frames 3, tolerance 0.06), attention.seed_percentile 95 / seed_threshold None, geometry.min_radius 0.005 (serve_safe builds AG3SConfig.from_dict without clustering/attention/geometry sections)
differences_from_live: point coordinates recorded as float32 (live used float64)
live ran the pre-T20 TargetConfirm; replay runs the working-tree one
cloud is the old self-filter output (apple erased for seq 12-21, T14.audit)

numbers.synthetic_fixture: blobs = tests/ag3s/test_manipulated_identity._lattice (27 pts, 8 mm), CFG = ClusteringConfig(min_points=10), seed_threshold 0.005, plus 2 support-excluded points at z=2 m carrying the raw-attention peak; APPLE (0.5,0,0.8), CRATE (0.5,0.5,0.8) from the test module; frames 0-2: apple 0.8 + crate 0.02 (apple score 0.5604)
numbers.synthetic_A_B_legend: A = apple kept in cloud at attention 0.05 (score 0.0354); B = apple absent. crate leads 10 frames; value = crate-attention frames until switch, null = none in 10

synthetic_C_occlusion_then_reobserve._what: 3 frames apple visible, K in {5,15,25} occluded frames, 3 frames apple back at offset {0,30,80} mm; occluder crate_low = crate alone at score 0.0143, no_cluster = status no_attention. ids: before / first return frame / third return frame

baseline_check.note: 13/15 · has_target 15/15 · frame0 +0.18597810857728936 mm — equal to the HEAD value in T19.verify.json; skill reference (14/15 · +0.15718632962849477) not reproduced, as in T19

verdict: 기준선: HEAD 값과 일치, skill 기준값과는 어긋남 (T19 와 같음). tests/ag3s: 673 passed, 14 warnings in 150.07s (0:02:30)
not_measured: pipeline-level replay (AG3S.step on T14 depth: fine window / target_field_exclude / guard centre with the manipulated object) — only ground_target + TargetConfirm were replayed
T14 replay with the T19 self-filter (apple kept in cloud) — cloud is the recorded old-filter one
process_note: verifier read T20.impl.md in full, including the section '내가 기대하는 결과', before measuring
